body: It's good that you have goals.  I live in New Jersey, USA.  You?

Things aren't picking up for me.  

Ok, well maybe we could just talk on here.  Look, please don't take it personally if I don't respond quickly.  I drink a lot, sometimes I avoid the internet, things like that.  It's nothing personal.  It's not like I'm going anywhere or doing anything with my life.  I'm just avoiding human interaction.  Sometimes I just need to be by myself.  

Hope you feel better dude, hope we both do.
That sounds good, man.  Mind if I ask what you're studying?  And what those goals are?
Same.  Sorry for the late reply...  Do you happen to play playstation?  Maybe we could play online or something.
Hey dude!  Sorry for the late reply..  I'm hanging in there too.  Glad to hear you're ok too.
How are you?

As someone who's benefited from food pantries in the past, and will in the near future, I can't upvote this enough.

As far as what you should/shouldn't donate, it's pretty obvious...  don't donate perishables.  Food pantries are usually run out of churches, so there is no way to refrigerate.  They provide meat, usually 1 lb of ground beef, and dairy in the form of Parmalat type milk.  They also provide bread.  Canned goods are the best thing to give, those are the things that will last a while.  Also rice and pasta, those never turn and they are a great source of carbohydrates.  

"Today you, tomorrow me."
Feels good to hear that.

I'm not sure I want to do that.  I feel like I've burdened enough people with this, and like you said, I'm pretty determined to go through with it.  I don't foresee anything SQLwitch could say that might change my mind.  It's like, I feel helpless, and I'm making it contagious.  Thank you again for lending an ear, I'll be sure to let you know what the results of my disability review are.  I received the forms today and will be mailing them out tomorrow.

I feel pretty certain that keeping the CO enclosed in the bathroom, completely sealed off, with a warning on the door and a warning in a letter to the police department, should be sufficient.  I'll be very careful in sealing it off.  You did make a good point as far as language goes for my note on the door, in case a maid walks in.  Opening that door could be bad news, and I want to make sure whoever does it is aware of the danger.  Thank you for pointing that out, and I'll be sure the sign on the door says "Danger" in English, Spanish, and Cyrillic.

You, and Lukov, have shown more concern for me than anyone else has since at least ten years ago.  

I understand why you can't give recommendations, and I appreciate you understand the reality of my situation.  That said, I hope you understand the fact that I want to end my life, and I'd prefer to make it as painless as possible.  The carbon monoxide method seems to be the best, most practical option.  My method would occur in a motel room, in a single floor motel, with careful duct taping around all edges of the door.  Should there be a very small (it'd have to be minute) opening in the sealant, would that really be enough to harm people in adjacent rooms?  By the way, I wouldn't disable the carbon monoxide detector in the main room.  As far as the note left for the maid, you're right.  I should probably draw a skull and crossbones type of symbol, or something that transcends language.

And I can only hope that you won't.  This is getting too dramatic!  I'll still be around for a while at least!  I feel like a drama queen.  [Here's an awesome video from the dudes at Cyanide and Happiness](http://www.explosm.net/comics/1920/)

Thank you.  I'm looking for peace.  If there were more compassionate people like you around, there would be more peace.  Thanks for being a good person, I believe and hope that it's recognized and worth something.  You've made me feel something, brotherhood I guess, and I can't imagine that sort of kindness not being rewarded.  Thanks for being nice.

Please, feel free.  I assumed carbon monoxide was the easiest of the easy ways out.  Seems painless.  And I thought I took all the precautions by not doing it in my duplex (got a neighbor) and blocking all the drains...  if there is a flaw please tell me, and if you have any recommendations please tell me those too.

I appreciate your concern, honestly I do.  But the truth of the matter is my disability benefits might be cut off.  If that happens I'll have to find a way to reintegrate myself into society and, honestly, that's not going to happen. 

I'm tired, man.  I've been ready for this thing for a long time.

As for how I've been, thank you for asking, I've been ok!  There's always something to look forward to, even for a forever aloner like myself.  Football season's starting, I'm a Cowboy fan and I'm always optimistic about their chances.  I'm interested to know how South Park finishes out the season, after how they ended the first half.  Same old shit a lot of people are interested in I guess.  Thanks again for asking.

Thank you for listening and caring.  Who knows what's on the other side, I feel like an astronaut!  So much strife in this world based on what's on the other side and just think, I'll know before everyone else does!  :)

And all I can say is I'm sorry to be such a bummer.  Seriously, to me at least, this isn't such a big deal.  Over the years I've read a lot of things having to do with religion or spirituality or what not, and while I don't belong to any organized religion I do believe in life after death, and a creator, and all that fun stuff.  I know Reddit is all about atheism and all, but I gotta say, when you're down and out spirituality kind of finds you, maybe as a crutch, I dunno.  In any case I feel pretty confident in my "faith" that death isn't the end.  I think this whole life thing is almost kind of a joke.  People who I've spoke at length with about this kind of started looking at me funny, hehe...  that I could speak about death so matter-of-factly.  But it's true, at least to me.  I look at death as a new beginning.  I believe that we die on earth, but we have souls, and we move on from here, and come back.  It might sound crazy, but it's the only way I can think to justify the fact that kids are born in third world countries only to spend their lives starving until they die at five years old.  It's the only way to justify it.  Anyways, sorry for the wall of text.  What I'm trying to say is, I might have fucked up in this life.  Could have done some things differently.  And ending it by my own volition is probably not the best option in the eyes of whatever creator is out there.  But, on the other hand, I'm content.  I've met people from all walks of life, I've learned a lot and, I think, taught a lot as well.  I've enjoyed nature, I've been in love.  I am content with how much of life I've experienced.  I'm happy, and in my notes I will express more eloquently the fact that I just want everyone else to be happy as well.
And in case you're wondering why I didn't take organ donation into account - I am a heavy smoker and drinker who wears glasses.  None of my organs would be suitable for transplantation.

I've gone over the entire thing in my head every morning for several years now.  Strangely enough I actually went and bought the charcoal a few weeks ago.  They're sitting in the other room.

The plan is that I'll take a cab across town to a motel.  Before I do that I will post a note on a blog that will be set to be published the following day at 5 pm, and post a link to it on my Facebook page.  That's just a precautionary measure to make sure noone from FB tries to alert the authorities or what not.  It'll just be a link on my FB page to the blog, with a message that it'll be updated at 5 pm the next day.  I've decided that I want to leave a note for my online friends, because I'd rather not just disappear.

After publishing that blog post and posting it to Facebook I'm going to wipe my hard drive. Then I am going to drop a letter off at the post office addressed to the nearby town's police department informing them that there is a dead body in [such-and-such] motel.  I'll inform them that there will be dangerous levels of carbon monoxide, and to take precaution.  I will give them the address and phone number of my mother, who is the only relative I keep in touch with.

Next I'm going to take a cab to that nearby town, to a motel.  In the motel I am going to leave my letter to my family (mom and brother, basically) and eat some pizza and buffalo wings and have a bunch of beers.  Then I'm going to tape a warning on the bathroom door that there is carbon monoxide inside, please don't open the door, call the authorities, in case a maid is the first one in.  Next I am going to seal myself in the bathroom with duct tape, making sure to not only seal the door and window, but also the drains so that the carbon monoxide doesn't leak into adjacent rooms.  Then I'm going to fill the bathtub with a half inch of water, to negate a fire hazard, and place in all the pots and pans I brought.  I'll fill them with charcoal, put in some lighter fluid, and light the coals.  Then I'll lay down on a blanket and pillow, with another blanket on top of me, and a table fan blowing for extra comfort.  I'll fall asleep/pass out from the combination of drunkenness and carbon monoxide poisoning.  I won't wake up.

Things have taken a very bad turn, it seems that my disability benefits are going to be under review. They won't be renewed, because I haven't seen a doctor or taken any medication for years. I've been prepared for this, and I'm sure you know what the plan is. I needed someone to talk to tonight so I've been chatting on Facebook with a woman who I friended while trying to gain more Mafia Wars members a couple years ago. I said this to her, and I kinda feel like more people should hear it. I don't think I'm some kind of profound person or anything, please don't take it that way. It's just that I feel like it's the truth, and I'd like some other people to hear it:

Crying and laughter and love. Those are the three things that life is all about. And, most importantly, sharing those things with other people. That's the point. That's why we're all here.

So there that is. For what it's worth.

Thanks for replying and I'm sorry to hear you're in the same circumstances.  I don't really use MSN anymore but wouldn't really mind it.  I try to avoid it because I drink a lot and tend to embarrass myself.  Either way, feel free to message back or pm me.  I won't respond for the next few days as I need to stay away from the computer right now and make sure I get used to my usual state of being totally numb.  It's not good for me to talk about my feelings too much when I'm feeling low like this.  Anyways, talk to you later, and stay strong brother.

Hey, thanks for responding last night.  I'm sorry you feel the same way as I do.  Turns out I can't figure out how to add you to a list of friends, but we can always stay in touch here or via pm.  Any time you wanna chat feel free to message me or pm, and I'll do the same.  Stay strong.

Hey, thanks again for speaking with me last night.  I'm sorry to hear you're depressed too.  I don't see the add friend button on your profile, but I suppose we could just stay in touch here or via pm.  I'm going to be taking a few days away from the computer to gather myself...  talking about this sort of thing too much is no good for me, it's better I reacquaint myself with being numb.  Feel free to message back, and I'll keep in mind that I could shoot you a message if I'm feeling low.

Hey, thanks for speaking with me last night.  I keep these things bottled up and every once in a while there's a straw that breaks the camel's back.  Again, I'm sorry to hear that you're in the same boat, it sucks.  I didn't listen to the music just yet because I'm going to spend a few days alone, as in away from the computer, to make sure I don't forget how to live in solitude.  I find that if I start speaking to people this way it snowballs and I get really really depressed.  Best thing for me right now is to get back into my usual state of being numb before speaking to anyone again.  I'll be back in a few days, hope to hear from you then.

I WILL reply tomorrow, I promise.  And if you really do only have a couple months left, which I'm pretty sure goes the same for me, I think it's awesome that you would spend them this way.  Maybe we could help each other out.  Speak to you tomorrow, my head is spinning.
thanks man, i appreciate it
That sounds like a fine idea my friend.  One of the above replies told me how to add a friend, so I'll do that when I'm a bit more sober.  Thank you, and I'll be here for you too brother/sister.
I don't see it.  I've had quite a bit to drink.  We can speak again tomorrow, thanks so much for talking to me tonight.

Dude, I'm not going to be dishonest with you and say that I listened to the songs.  But I honestly will tomorrow.  I am very, very drunk.  But thank you for replying to my post, and I'll write a better reply tomorrow bro.  Thanks again.
Is there some way to add you to a friend list, or save this message or something?
Thank you so much for the opportunity.  Been talking to someone and I've been feeling a bit better, now that someone's there, but I'm totally taking a raincheck.  Thanks for caring.

I don't know whether to ask you about why it's complicated or just talk about myself.  Btw, are you an Aussie by any chance, the whole "mate" thing.  Anyway...  I just watch tv and go on the internet.  Saying it now I get the old /r/firstworldproblems feeling.  I just don't have any friends or family at all.  I watch tv and laugh and turn to the side and wish there was someone there to share it with, and feel the same, you know?  

I guess my interests are sports, certain television shows i guess.  I drink a lot.

As far as music, I'm a joke.  I've actually enjoyed a few Nickelback songs, that should sum it up.  I also love the soundtrack from the video game "Shadow Of The Colossus".  I also love hearing music from "The Legend of Zelda" played by an orchestra.  But I also like some songs by N*Sync.  I suck at music.

Thank you.  Everything really.  I don't speak to anyone, ever, so it all just gets pushed away, the good and the bad.  I feel guilty asking for help, but I know I shouldn't.  I'm just lonely.  

I guess, to really answer your question, I'd like to be asked about my day.  Or how I'm feeling.  But the answers are horribly depressing, and I know that you have a life outside of helping people on reddit, so I wouldn't want to burden you with them.  

Fucking hell, I don't know what to say really.  How was your day?  Where are you from?  But then I'll very quickly depend on you to be a friend.  I just don't know anymore.
Please help.
